linkedin.post:
$15,330 a year. That is what Bupa's "Enhanced Dining Experience" costs an aged care resident, about $42 a day, an ABC investigation reports. It includes two hot breakfasts a week; residents who don't pay get a continental breakfast.

Bupa says it will provide cooked protein if a dietitian recommends it. Dietitians Australia says most people expect an egg at breakfast.

The fee sits under the Higher Everyday Living Fee rules, which say such services must be optional and beyond required care.

Should a hot breakfast in aged care be a paid extra, or part of every resident's care?

Tell us what you think below.

#AusSight #auspol #agedcare
